name: 49445 · Muskegon, MI
findings: ZIP 49445 (Muskegon) has 65 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 20 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49445 (Muskegon) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 49445 (Muskegon) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 48% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
